trims.ps:p36-staff-process: well it's kind of this how it works in military planning anyway so in anything above battlegroup level [our 'strategic'] there would be a staff there that would work up plans socialise those plans amongst themselves and back brief me as a commander. I would then go okay yeah I want you a bit of that plan and a bit of that plan give me this new plan. They'll go and write up by then sort of basically finish off that way. So it's a it is always a collective input into it but I'm just getting the synthesis of them work because I can't as an individual I couldn't work through the ground the enemy, the enemy's plan, the likelihood of my plan succeeding, the logistics behind it it would take me forever which is why your staff do it, so at that level you're already in a position where somebody's just coming back to you with the answers as long as you have trust in how they've come up with those answers then if it looks right: because you've gone through the process yourself [...] you'd have worked up in those levels so you kind of understand how those answers are generated so there's a level of trust in that process
trims.ps:p36-trust-but-verify: I write a plan I will go and take it to the lowest tactical level which is something like this where you're moving different units around different people you'd probably speak to the platoon commander you'd speak to the platoon sergeant: 'I'm thinking of doing this', you'd bring your section commanders in you'd go through yours and that's the process 'guys this is what I'm thinking and this is what your likely mission is, go away and work out the plan'. [...] As humans we should be used to socialising our decision making process to an extent. How you do that is entirely up to the commander but at the same time I'm still going through a process where somebody is checking my thinking and has the option to challenge me so with AI it should always be open to challenge [...] but also trust in the fact it's done the maths behind it and has allocated enough platforms to do the task you're after
trims.ps:p36-play-catch-up: If I've sent that off it allows me to scan over here and then go back and check the answer over there.
